rationale: As the assigning justice and a high-confidence vote, Justice Thomas is most likely to keep the majority together around a Kelly/Ciminelli-consistent rule requiring an intended deprivation of traditional economic value in the bargain, while rejecting a freestanding net-loss element. The Chief Justice is the most likely dissenter (possibly with Justice Barrett and/or Justice Alito) defending a Durland-style fraudulent-inducement theory where obtaining money by material deception suffices without proving diminished value.
